source_caption:
I Love You, Beth Cooper (2009) is a teen comedy based on the novel by Larry Doyle. The story follows Denis Cooverman, a nerdy valedictorian played by Paul Rust, who unexpectedly confesses his love for the most popular girl in school, Beth Cooper, during his graduation speech. Beth, played by Hayden Panettiere, surprisingly shows up at Denis’s house that night with her wild friends, leading to a chaotic and unforgettable adventure.

The movie mixes awkward humor with teenage fantasies as Denis gets a chance to experience the “cool” life he always admired. Throughout the night, he learns that Beth isn’t as perfect as she seems, and she learns to appreciate Denis’s honesty and kindness. Directed by Chris Columbus, the film explores themes of self-confidence, identity, and stepping out of your comfort zone, all wrapped in a light, comedic tone.

source_details.title: I Love You, Beth Cooper
source_details.synopsis: I Love You, Beth Cooper is a 2009 American teen romantic comedy film directed by Chris Columbus and starring Hayden Panettiere and Paul Rust. It is based on the novel by Larry Doyle, with Doyle also writing the film's screenplay. I Love You, Beth Cooper was released by 20th Century Fox on July 10, 2009. The film received negative reviews and underperformed at the box office, grossing $16.4 million against an $18 million budget.
